text:
sam: FYI — AtlasLogistics reporting 12 H100s on AWB 1Z999AA12345 stuck at FRA customs. Reason given: HS code mismatch + missing commercial invoice. Vendor says they can refile but needs corrected invoice and PO copy. Any quick path? :eyes:

maria: Can you paste AWB and PO? I'll ping procurement/legal.

sam: AWB: `1Z999AA12345`  PO: `PO-95271` — courier contact: +49 30 555-0123

claire: If customs wants different HS, can vendor change carrier description without incurring duties? cc @lee-finance

eli-atlas: We can reclassify under 8471.50 or provide a proforma, turnaround 48–72h once we have corrected invoice. Customs backlog may add an extra 24–72h. We can expedite clearance for a brokerage surcharge of ~€1,200 per AWB.

sam: Oof. Do we have spare H100s in EU to cover next-week demand? infra-bot, any capacity impact?

infra-bot: ALERT: expected GPU capacity shortfall in 'infer-prod-eu' ~10% starting 2025-06-05 if in-transit units delayed >72h. Suggested: backfill from pool-east or throttle non-critical jobs.

ton y: We also have 2 DOA units on current RMA queue that vendor could prioritize as replacements. eli-atlas, can RMA units be swapped against these in-transit ones to skip customs redoc?

eli-atlas: We can attempt a swap but need serials + signed RMA labels before handover. If you confirm serials by EOD we can re-route as replacements and file urgent clearance. Swap avoids surcharge in many cases.

maria: I'll pull serials from the manifest and drop them here in 30m. Prefer swap if it avoids the €1.2k fee.

lee-finance: If we must pay surcharge, approve under GL code 5003 — procurement will need an invoice line and vendor justification. Otherwise finance prefers refile option.

claire: Plan: 1) maria posts serials 2) eli confirms swap feasibility 3) if swap not possible, procurement approves surcharge. :+1:

sam: Thanks — I'm on the call with Atlas in 15. Will update thread with next steps and any AWB status links.

eli-atlas: Contact for customs team: anna.bucher@atlaslog.com, ref `FRA-H100-95271`. Will standby for docs.

sam: Added.
